item.title: Preparing for a career in fintech: A conversation with Cho-Nan Tsai, a Fintech CTO
item.description:
I recently gave an interview on the topic of career preparation in fintech. The interview was conducted by Trilogy Education Service which is the company that’s running Fintech Bootcamp program at Columbia Unviersity. The entire interview is here.

The article/interview was published in summer 2021 on Columbia Engineering School Bootcamp Program website
